import CategoryTheory.HomotopyCategory
import CategoryTheory.Abelian
import CategoryTheory.ThickSubcategory
import CategoryTheory.VerdierLocalization

open CategoryTheory

theorem lg_target {C : Type u_1} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v_1, u_1} C] [CategoryTheory.Abelian C] : 
  (HomotopyCategory.plus C).IsVerdierRightLocalizing (HomotopyCategory.subcategoryAcyclic C) := by
  let H := HomotopyCategory.plus C
  let A := HomotopyCategory.subcategoryAcyclic C

  -- Step 1: Show that A is thick in H
  have h_thick : A.IsThick := by
    refine Subcategory.IsThick.of_thin_and_closed_under_extensions_and_direct_summands _
    · exact A.IsThin
    · intro X Y
      cases X with X' X'_is_zero
      cases Y with Y' Y'_is_zero
      cases X'_is_zero with X' X'_is_zero
      cases Y'_is_zero with Y' Y'_is_zero
      refine (HomotopyCategory.extens _ _ _).is_in_subcategory _
      exact (HomotopyCategory.extens _ _ _).is_in_subcategory _
    · intro X
      cases X with X' X'_is_zero
      refine (HomotopyCategory.direct_summand _ _).is_in_subcategory _
      exact (HomotopyCategory.direct_summand _ _).is_in_subcategory _

  -- Step 2: Show that the quotient by A is idempotent complete
  have h_idempotent_complete : (H / A).IsIdempotentComplete := by
    apply QuotientCategory.IsIdempotentComplete.of_idempotent_complete_quotient
    apply HomotopyCategory.idempotent_complete

  -- Step 3: Use the characterization of Verdier right localizing subcategories
  exact H.IsVerdierRightLocalizing_of_thick_and_idempotent_complete h_thick h_idempotent_complete
